findings.title: Recurrent descent after the initial sending

findings.mechanism: The focus carrier تَنَزَّلُ carries downward, gradual descent through root_001492/B001, while the sending branch root_001492/B002 and the completed delivery in 97:1 provide the local phase relation; 14:1 supplies a wider permission-bound sending parallel.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish an operational arrival and distribution from a redundant repetition of 97:1.
findings.containment: This does not make every descent recurrent or identify the agents' exact task; the gradual and repeated-delivery facets remain a qualified reading.

epistemic.reason: The published support is trusted and the focus carrier is exact; the wider parallel is contextual rather than a new lexical fact.

findings.mechanism: The reassurance descent in 41:30, the devil-descent boundary in 26:210, and the relief route in 12:87 return through the Spirit and descent carriers, giving the surrounding verses a convergent counter-reading.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can reread the focus descent after 97:5 as a peaceful, relieving, and life-oriented action.
findings.containment: This is legacy_unbound retrospective evidence; it does not turn every surrounding image into a literal component of 97:4.

epistemic.reason: The supplied reader walk is explicitly retrospective and inferred, but each retained branch has an exact focus carrier and concrete wider trigger.

branch_activations.activation: The focus carrier for bedene canlılık veren iç varlık meets Reassurance, hostile-descent contrast, and relief return through the Spirit carrier; the contact yields the bounded reading stated below.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The Spirit's descent is retrospectively read as life-bearing and safe
branch_activations.boundary: The reading remains an attributed synthesis.
